data.name: Fire and Water: Spirits of the Forest
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

A Shoulder-to-Shoulder Adventure

Looking for a two-player game to strengthen the bond with your friend, partner, child, or parents? A true test of cooperation awaits you in this vibrant, untouched world!

Play How You Want

How you embark on this adventure is entirely up to you. Play side-by-side or with your favorite setup:

  • Single Keyboard: 2 players on the same keyboard

  • Mixed: Keyboard + Gamepad

  • Dual Gamepads: 2 Gamepads

  • For Lone Wolves: Want to experience this inner journey alone? Take control of both characters and play solo.

Discover the Forces of Nature

Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Diamond, Shadow, and Electricity... Each forest spirit features entirely different gameplay mechanics suited to their nature. Master your favorite character's skills to overcome challenging puzzles, and always cooperate with your partner to clear platforms.

An Ever-Changing World

From the depths of the forest to snowy peaks and harsh deserts, you will encounter brand new level designs and obstacles. The solution lies in your wits, your agility, and sometimes simply in trusting your teammate.

No Violence, Only Solutions

There is no destruction in this peaceful world. You cannot harm the mutant plants you encounter; our goal is to save them from their curse. Outsmart them to neutralize them briefly and continue safely.

Ready for a peaceful yet challenging adventure that brings inner feelings to the forefront? Solve together, progress together!
